data.body: Client ruling 2026-10-05: no second room. Refuse creating a room on a question while another unreleased room holds it.

DISPATCH (orchestrator, 10-06 07:3x) on the client's word ('Dispatch PQ-54'). Mode inline-full. Worktree /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/one-room-per-question, branch ai-c11-cc/one-room-per-question off origin/main @ e239346. Rulings: (1) a room holds its question while not Released and not ended(now); (2) the check and the insert under one rooms lock; decide whether the used check moves under it; (3) Run it again reaches the same check; the released source room does not count; (4) schedule() unchanged; (5) one new refusal sentence per SPEC §11, carried to the client for approval, plus a RUNBOOK failure-table row; (6) out of scope: smoke/burst --question q3 default (GAP-21), the machine-wide take_home, deploy, contract files. The tag 'held' stays; the client released this ticket for this dispatch.
READY PQ-54 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/one-room-per-question HEAD e239346f938896c91f14bc6a299fd3fce8d0bb7f BASE e239346f938896c91f14bc6a299fd3fce8d0bb7f MODE active

BLOCKED PQ-54: third commit (latch an ended room's ending in create_for, from the automated security review) is staged but cannot be signed. git commit: '1Password: failed to fill whole buffer' twice; ssh-keygen fallback via the 1Password agent socket (key listed by ssh-add -l): 'communication with agent failed'. Two signed commits already on the branch (4dfcf0c, d4d7859). Waiting for the client to unlock/approve 1Password.

ORCHESTRATOR FIX-BACK (exact-head review of b93de4f: PASS-WITH-NITS, attached). Review cycle 1 of the cap. One docs-only signed commit after the push, then push it, then FIXED PQ-54 HEAD <sha>, stay at review: (1) docs/RUNBOOK.md:326, give the numbers: a room stops holding its question after 30 minutes with no host action while it waits to start, 20 minutes once started, 4 hours at most (lifecycle.rs IDLE_QUIET/LATER_QUIET, rooms.rs ROOM_LIFETIME); and say what to do if the saved host-screen address is lost: wait for the room to go quiet, or pick another question. (2) In DONE and the PR body, do not call the thread test a witness for the lock: the questions lock serializes creates, so only the structural test guards the critical section; say that. (3) NIT: wrap the long doc line near rooms.rs:988. Leave the latch as is. Do not merge.
